switch.label: Daily routine
switch.description: Opens the shutters in the morning and closes them in the evening. When it is off, the daily routine moves nothing.

general.title: Daily routine
general.description: How far the shutters open and close, how workdays, weekends and public holidays are told apart, and what else can start the evening. The times follow on the next pages, one page for each kind of day.

workday.title: Daily routine on workdays
workday.description: When the morning and the evening begin on a workday.

weekend.title: Daily routine on weekends
weekend.description: When the morning and the evening begin on a Saturday or Sunday, or on a day that the workday entity reports as a day off.

holiday.title: Daily routine on public holidays
holiday.description: When the morning and the evening begin on a day that the holiday entity reports as a public holiday.

schedule_morning_position.label: Morning position
schedule_morning_position.description: How far the shutter opens in the morning: 100 % is fully open, 0 % fully closed. In the morning a shutter is only raised; if it is already higher, it stays where it is.

schedule_evening_position.label: Evening position
schedule_evening_position.description: How far the shutter closes in the evening: 100 % is fully open, 0 % fully closed. In the evening a shutter is only lowered; if it is already lower, it stays where it is.

schedule_evening_position_summer.label: Evening position in summer
schedule_evening_position_summer.description: Used instead of the evening position in summer, for example 30 % for privacy with some fresh air. It only applies if summer is set by an entity or by date.

schedule_workday_source.label: Workday entity
schedule_workday_source.description: An entity that is on on workdays, for example a workday sensor of Home Assistant. With "None", Monday to Friday are workdays.

schedule_holiday_source.label: Holiday entity
schedule_holiday_source.description: An entity that is on on public holidays; a calendar with an all-day event works too. With "None", there are no public holidays.

schedule_season_source.label: Summer entity
schedule_season_source.description: An entity that is on while it is summer. While it is unavailable or unknown, its last known state is used.

schedule_summer_by_date.label: Summer by date
schedule_summer_by_date.description: Without a summer entity, summer lasts from the first to the last day set below.

schedule_summer_first_day.label: First day of summer
schedule_summer_first_day.description: Month and day, two digits each, for example 05-01 for 1 May.

schedule_summer_last_day.label: Last day of summer
schedule_summer_last_day.description: Month and day, two digits each, for example 09-30 for 30 September. Summer may run across the turn of the year.

schedule_brightness_source.label: Outdoor brightness entity
schedule_brightness_source.description: An entity that reports the outdoor brightness in lux. If it stays darker than the threshold for the set duration, the evening begins early, but never earlier than the time set in "Evening: not before". While the entity is unavailable or unknown, it neither starts nor delays the evening.

schedule_brightness_threshold_lux.label: Brightness threshold (lux)
schedule_brightness_threshold_lux.description: Below this outdoor brightness, in lux, it counts as dark.

schedule_brightness_delay.label: Duration of darkness
schedule_brightness_delay.description: For how many minutes it has to be dark before the evening begins.

schedule_random_offset.label: Random offset
schedule_random_offset.description: Moves each morning and evening by up to this many minutes, earlier or later, differently for each window and each day. 0 turns it off; 30 is the maximum.

kind.label: [edge]: trigger
kind.description: A fixed time; sunrise in the morning or sunset in the evening, with an offset; or the elevation of the sun. For the two that follow the sun, "not before" and "not after" in the advanced settings set the earliest and the latest time.

offset_minutes.label: [edge]: offset to sunrise or sunset
offset_minutes.description: Used with the trigger "Sunrise or sunset". In minutes; a negative number means earlier.

elevation.label: [edge]: elevation of the sun
elevation.description: Used with the trigger "Elevation of the sun". In degrees above the horizon; a negative number means below it.

not_before.label: [edge]: not before
not_before.description: The earliest time for a trigger that follows the sun. On a day on which the sun gives no time, for example because it never reaches the chosen elevation, this time or "not after" is used instead.

not_after.label: [edge]: not after
not_after.description: The latest time for a trigger that follows the sun.
